title: Day 795: Gunmen Storm Home in Urbi Villas del Sol, Culiacán, Killing Three Men
detail: Shortly after 2:00 PM on Friday, September 25, 2026, armed individuals entered a residence on Avenida Misión Balleza, between Misión Mulegé and Misión Viñadaco, in the Urbi Villas del Sol subdivision, Capistrano sector of Culiacán, and opened fire on the occupants. Mexican Army personnel arriving at the scene found three men with gunshot wounds; Red Cross paramedics confirmed all three had died before treatment. The victims were identified as José de Jesús, 55, Aníbal, 39, and a third man known by the alias 'El Caimán.' Investigative police and state forensic experts recovered shell casings from large-caliber firearms; no arrests were reported.

media.caption: Security response at the Urbi Villas del Sol residence where three men were shot dead, Capistrano sector, Culiacán, September 25, 2026

title: Day 795: Motorcyclist Killed, Companion Wounded in Ambush on Colinas del Real, Mazatlán
detail: At approximately 3:15 PM on September 25, 2026, armed subjects intercepted a couple riding a black-and-yellow motorcycle on Calle Colina Baja in the Colinas del Real subdivision, Mazatlán, and opened fire. The male driver, identified as José Luis 'N', died at the scene; his passenger, Karely 'N', was wounded and transported for medical treatment. Police recovered spent shell casings; no arrests were reported.

media.caption: Security forces at the scene of a fatal motorcycle ambush in Colinas del Real, Mazatlán, September 25, 2026

title: Day 795: Five Armed Attacks Sweep Mazatlán Neighborhoods in a Single Afternoon
detail: Security corporations mobilized across Mazatlán on the afternoon of September 25, 2026 after at least five armed attacks were reported within a few hours. On Calle Pachuca near Michoacán in the Sánchez Celis neighborhood, gunmen shot and wounded two men around 5:34 PM. In the Benito Juárez neighborhood, armed men fired an automatic rifle and a 9mm pistol at the facade of a home on Calle Montes de Oca near Avenida Insurgentes, causing property damage but no injuries. In the Buenos Aires neighborhood, a bystander on Calle Arturo Medrano was struck by a stray round apparently linked to the same-day Colinas del Real motorcycle ambush. Municipal, state and federal forces responded across all sites; no arrests were reported.

media.caption: Security response after a wave of five armed attacks across Mazatlán neighborhoods, September 25, 2026

title: Day 795: Federal Forces Detain Eight in Seven Mazatlán-Area Operations, Seize Explosives and Fentanyl
detail: Federal, state and municipal security forces carried out seven operations in and around Mazatlán on September 25, 2026, including in El Quelite, Veranos and Siqueros, detaining eight people. One detainee was identified as an operator of a criminal faction linked to homicides and other high-impact crimes. Security Secretariat (SSPC) agents were attacked with gunfire during patrols in El Quelite, where six of the eight arrests were made. Seizures across the operations included 19 firearms (6 long guns), more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, 12 magazines, 14 homemade explosive devices, 6 tactical vests, 415 fentanyl pills and 2 vehicles. The operations form part of President Sheinbaum's security reinforcement initiative for Mazatlán.
